data.title: GitHub Actions CI Failure Analysis and Context Store Strategy
data.summary_text:
GitHub Action Failure Analysis Tool Development
Built automated tool to analyze failed GitHub actions
Claude/Codex created app running locally on Dallas's laptop
Analyzes PR failures and categorizes root causes
Currently uses hardcoded HTML strings, no real data integration
Context Store and Agent Connector Demo
Demonstrated context store functionality to Dot (customer)
Signed up immediately after demo for sales intelligence layer
Want to avoid hitting 4-5 different endpoints for agent data retrieval
Technical implementation:
Replication connector with API endpoint (V0 version)
Uses MotherDuck as database with built-in embeddings function
Single API endpoint exposes all synced data
Tool calls priced at $49/month for 1,000-5,000 calls per workspace
